## Natural history notes

A medium-sized tree squirrel characterized by its gray to brownish-gray fur, white underside, and long bushy tail. In Florida, it is commonly found in hardwood forests, hammocks, pine-oak woodlands, parks, yards, and suburban areas with mature trees. It feeds mainly on acorns, nuts, seeds, fruits, fungi, and buds, often nesting in tree cavities or leafy nests in the canopy.
